rec.name: Multiple Product Videos (Story-Style Video Popups)
rec.status: Built — launched (static theme-editor version; metafield/metaobject version tracked in a separate ticket)

what.text: A Shopify PDP section showing a heading (e.g. "Die Verwendung" / "How to use") above a horizontal row of round (or square) video thumbnails with captions, in the style of Instagram stories. Each thumbnail can show a play icon. Clicking one opens a modal popup that plays that item's video, with a title and a description. Content is entered per item in the theme customizer.

why.text: Short, tap-to-watch videos show how the product is used, styled or applied without forcing a long page read. This reduces uncertainty and helps shoppers picture owning the product, so they are more likely to add to cart. The familiar story-style UI invites curiosity and engagement, and keeping the video in a popup leaves the buy box and scroll position untouched. Multiple short clips let shoppers pick the use case that matters to them.

how.text: Create a new section file in the theme (the instructions file names it ed-multiple-product-videos.liquid) and paste the code. Add the section to the Product template in the theme customizer and place it under the buy box or product info. Set the heading, sub-headline, colors and font sizes. Add one "Item" block per video with a thumbnail image, video, caption/title and popup description. The ticket's own settings: background color, font color, font size, headline, sub-headline, and per-video thumbnail, video, title and popup description. Later additions: uppercase heading toggle, display on/off toggle with an A/B-test CSS override, separate desktop and mobile spacing and font sizes, alignment, and video controls (controls, autoplay, muted, loop, width, rounded corners). The JS must pause the video when the popup is closed. Test on desktop and mobile. Videos are static per section and cannot differ per product; unique videos per product need the separate metaobject/metafield version.

items: Display section toggle (with CSS override for A/B tests)
Heading font size (desktop and mobile) and color
Item blocks (one per video): thumbnail, video, title, popup description
Popup close button color and size
Video settings: controls, autoplay, muted, loop, video width, rounded corners
Modal content settings: gap, icon size (desktop and mobile), icon color and background

dependencies.text: Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme with a product template. Needs custom Liquid, CSS and JS for the popup and for pausing video on close. No metafields or metaobjects for this static version (clarified in comments). Do NOT confuse with 'CRO | PDP | Multiple Product Videos via Metafields', which is a separate ticket that requires product metafields pointing to metaobjects. The popup in the reference code reuses theme modal components. Duplicate the theme before installing.

images.caption: Live PDP: 'Die Verwendung' heading with five square video thumbnails with play icons and captions, shown under the buy box.
Theme editor: the Multiple Product Videos section with five Item blocks, plus display toggle, background, spacing, alignment and heading settings.
Heading settings: heading text, Uppercase/Normal style, desktop and mobile font size, color; circular thumbnails with captions.
Customizer settings panel: popup close button, video settings (controls, autoplay, muted, loop, width, rounded) and modal content settings.
Popup modal example: video on the left, numbered title and description items with thumbnails on the right, close button top left (from the related metafield version).
